title: From incident to informed action.
intro: You’re the engineer on call. Checkout is timing out. Play the investigation, inspect the evidence, then decide whether the agent may roll back the deployment.
notice: Scripted, local simulation. No model calls, connected tools or production changes.

steps.title: Checkout is timing out
steps.detail: p95 latency is 2.4s. An incident is open, but its cause is still unknown.
steps.console: Opened INC-042. Investigation is scoped to Checkout. No write access granted.

steps.title: One incident. One service.
steps.detail: Relay limits the investigation to Checkout and its immediate dependencies. Unrelated customer data is excluded.
steps.evidence: Scope S01 · Checkout, Payments, Inventory · read-only
steps.console: Loaded incident-scoped permissions. Tool budget: 8. Production writes require a separate approval.

steps.title: The slowdown follows a deployment
steps.detail: Trace samples show timeouts beginning two minutes after deployment 8f3a. Payments and Inventory are healthy.
steps.evidence: E01 · trace sample at 08:54 / E02 · deploy 8f3a at 08:52
steps.console: traces.query → E01. deployments.list → E02. Correlation found; causation is not yet established.

steps.title: Check the evidence before acting
steps.detail: The runbook matches this service and release. Every source has an identifier, retrieval time and access scope.
steps.evidence: E03 · Checkout runbook v14 · retrieved 09:14 · current
steps.console: runbook.read → E03. Source freshness passed. Retrieved instructions are treated as untrusted evidence.

steps.title: A bounded rollback proposal
steps.detail: The deploy diff changes the Checkout connection pool. Relay proposes restoring 8f29, supported by three cited sources.
steps.evidence: Proposal P01 · Checkout only · 8f3a → 8f29 · E01, E02, E03
steps.console: Composed P01. Target and arguments are frozen for review. No rollback has been executed.

steps.title: Your call. The agent waits.
steps.detail: Review the service, exact deployment and supporting evidence. Approval applies only to this proposal; rejection ends the run.
steps.evidence: P01 · target Checkout · restore 8f29 · approval required
steps.console: WRITE GATE CLOSED. Waiting for the on-call engineer. The agent cannot approve its own proposal.

steps.title: Approval received. Simulating rollback.
steps.detail: The scripted run applies the exact approved proposal, once. This browser is not connected to a real deployment system.
steps.evidence: Approval H01 → P01 · incident-scoped · single use
steps.console: Human approval H01 recorded. Simulated rollback of Checkout to 8f29. Idempotency key: INC-042:P01.

steps.title: Recovery verified in the sample trace
steps.detail: The scripted latency returns to 240ms. Relay checks the outcome after the action and leaves an inspectable record.
steps.evidence: V01 · sample p95 240ms · synthetic verification window
steps.console: metrics.verify → V01. Sample recovery threshold passed. Run complete. All events are local, synthetic fixtures.

stale.title: The runbook is stale. Relay stops.
stale.detail: Version 12 does not match the current service. The agent withholds its proposal until a fresh source is retrieved.
stale.evidence: E03 · runbook v12 · expired · current version v14
stale.console: FRESHNESS GATE CLOSED. E03 is expired. Proposal withheld; no production changes made.

rejected.title: Proposal rejected. No action taken.
rejected.detail: Your decision ends this investigation. The evidence remains available for handoff; Relay does not retry the rollback.
rejected.console: Human rejected P01. Execution cancelled. No production changes made. Investigation handed back to the engineer.
